Wow. Scott Pelley says of new 60 Minutes leadership: "New management has instructed me to inject falsehoods and bias into a politically sensitive story. I’ve been told to include assertions that are unverified."


Dylan Byers (@DylanByers)

There has never been anything in America like 60 Minutes.

On Friday, the Department of Housing and Urban Development released its annual homelessness report showing a 3.3% nationwide decline during Biden's last year in office, marking the first decrease since 2016.

When George Santos was sitting in prison, he said if he ever got free he’d dedicate his life to prison reform. Now that Trump pardoned and freed him, he’s insider trading on Kalshi:


Judd Legum (@JuddLegum)

George Santos:

1. Posted a video the day before Trump's State of the Union saying he was going to be there

2. Bet on Kalshi that he would not attend

3. Did not attend

Trump taps Bill Pulte as Acting Director of National Intelligence — says he will also remain in his current roles as well (director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency and chairman of Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac)
